_comment: Pre-registered BEFORE any C2 result was seen (2026-08-02). Baseline is P1 no-clip on the frozen 145 clean pairs with the same stratified grouped 5-fold CV used throughout this project, seed 0. Fusion is a simple 0.5/0.5 average of P1's calibrated sigmoid score and C2's train-fold-normalized left/right distance -- adopting a more sophisticated fusion (e.g. feeding C2 distance into P1's logistic regression as an extra feature, as C1 did) is a DIFFERENT experiment and needs its own gate, not a retroactive change to this one.
watch_subtype_note: regrasp_reposition + direction_reversal false-positive rate (at the median-of-true-positives cutoff) must not increase by more than this much after adding C2 -- this is the specific failure mode C1 exhibited and C2 exists to fix; a pass on overall AUROC that makes THIS worse is not a pass.
